_question_paper: Old_Questions/Direct_2023-2025/Jr. Grade of MES (Electrical Wing) under P&E Deptt., General Studies..pdf (sha256:64517f3b488f9058)
_answer_key: Answer_Keys/Jr. Grade of MES, P&E Cadre (Electrical Wing) under P&E Deptt. Final Answer Key..pdf (sha256:99cf176202c7c3f7), General Studies page (page 1 of 10), Final Answer Key dated 8 September 2023
_files_live_in: mpsc-question-bank repo - a DIFFERENT repo, hence this transcription
_paper_extraction: pdftotext -layout; the paper has a 24,496-char text layer so questions were parsed, not read by eye. Parser requires SEQUENTIAL question numbers and SEQUENTIAL option letters - the rule that fixes the Oct-2025 Q62 bug, where an option reading 'Both (b) and (c)' was split on its embedded markers and left an option EMPTY. Page numbers ('-2-') are stripped before parsing so they cannot land inside a stem. Verified: 100 questions, each with exactly options A-D, none empty. AND a coverage check the Oct-2025 parse did not have: the parsed records are reassembled into the source's own shape and required to match the PDF text character for character from Q1 to the end - all 15,440 chars accounted for. The empty-option assertion only fires on damage that empties a field; coverage also catches damage that DROPS one, which is the 2026-08-04 silent-loss class (~280 questions gone with no numbering gap to reveal it).
_key_extraction: pdftotext -layout on the key PDF, which has a real 26,501-char text layer, so the table was parsed rather than OCR'd or read by eye. The General Studies page prints four (Q. No., Ans.) column pairs; the parser reads every '<n> (<A-D>)' pair on that page and aborts if any question number yields two different letters. 100/100 entries. CROSS-CHECKED against a second file: MPSC filed the same key twice, once under the P&E Cadre name and once as 'Assistant Architect (Contract) under PWD Final Answer Key..pdf' (the two posts sat the same paper). Parsing that second PDF independently gives 100/100 identical letters, so the transcription is confirmed by a second source rather than trusted from one parse.
_no_provisional: Unlike the Oct-2025 sitting, no provisional key for this exam is in the Answer_Keys folder - only this final one, so there is no earlier key to supersede or to disagree with.
